author: artlbv
body:
#### PR description:

`L1Trigger/Configuration/python/customisePhase2.py` contains a second copy of `customisePhase2TTNoMC`. It still uses the sequence labels from before the l1t renaming (`L1PromptExtendedHybridTracksWithAssociators`, `L1PromptExtendedHybridTracks`), so `--customise L1Trigger/Configuration/customisePhase2.customisePhase2TTNoMC` fails with

```
AttributeError: 'Process' object has no attribute 'L1PromptExtendedHybridTracksWithAssociators'
```

The maintained version is in `customisePhase2TTNoMC.py`; it was updated in the renaming, but this copy was missed. Nothing in the release uses this copy (all configurations import from `customisePhase2TTNoMC.py`). This PR replaces it with an import of the maintained function, so the old name keeps working.

#### PR validation:

In `CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-11-05-2300`, `cmsDriver.py -s L1TrackTrigger,L1,L1P2GT` (Run4D128):
- **Before:** with `--customise L1Trigger/Configuration/customisePhase2.customisePhase2TTNoMC`, cmsDriver fails with the error above.
- **After:** with either `customisePhase2.customisePhase2TTNoMC` or `customisePhase2TTNoMC.customisePhase2TTNoMC`, cmsDriver produces identical configurations (`edmConfigDump`).
- **`cmsRun`:** the configuration runs on 3 locally produced D128 TTbar GEN-SIM-DIGI-RAW events (exit code 0).

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Not a backport.
title: [L1T Phase-2] Fix customisePhase2.customisePhase2TTNoMC
